tools.name: catalog.search
tools.purpose: Find candidate sources/services/repos by feature terms; does not establish the failing component.
tools.constraints: Authorization filters metadata before return; bounded indexed discovery, not raw estate scanning.

tools.name: catalog.describe
tools.purpose: Describe one discovered source, capabilities, relationships and freshness.
tools.constraints: Declared relationships are leads, not automatically runtime truth.

tools.name: history.search
tools.purpose: Retrieve useful precedent or intended-behavior documents.
tools.constraints: No ground-truth labels or future fixes from held-out evaluation cases; precedent is not current causal proof.

tools.name: case.read
tools.purpose: Read a bounded current, review or report snapshot and its references.
tools.constraints: D8 restricted to assigned report snapshot; D7 gets independent review snapshot.

tools.name: evidence.fetch
tools.backend: Evidence registry plus authorized original-source fetch
tools.purpose: Fetch cited original excerpts or accepted shared artifacts, including code-to-data read contracts.
tools.constraints: Recheck access on every fetch; selectors/ranges are bounded, secrets redacted, no unrestricted URL fetch.

tools.name: delegate_task
tools.purpose: Validate a task proposal, reserve budget and enqueue it once; runtime assigns IDs/revisions.
tools.constraints: Validate role_input against target Task schema; clamp limits, check prerequisites and review gates; same key returns same task.

tools.name: request_clarification
tools.purpose: Record and present a focused missing-scope question to the user.
tools.constraints: Pending means no user answer yet; agent cannot manufacture one or keep investigating an arbitrarily chosen candidate.

tools.name: telemetry.describe_sources
tools.purpose: Inspect queryable fields, retention, sampling and supported correlation/status operations.
tools.constraints: No implied cloud integration when the source/operation is unconfigured.

tools.name: telemetry.aggregate
tools.purpose: Run bounded counts/rates/distributions to narrow time, service or cohort.
tools.constraints: Validate fields and denominator/units; scan caps plus page caps; no arbitrary backend query language.

tools.name: telemetry.query_events
tools.purpose: Fetch relevant original log/event records using validated terms, IDs and filters.
tools.constraints: Distinguish event/ingestion time; query exhaustion is not proof of absent execution.

tools.name: telemetry.fetch_trace
tools.purpose: Read a specific trace and bounded span summaries/links.
tools.constraints: Trace sampling/partial retention exposed; async work need not share a single trace.

tools.name: telemetry.correlate_messages
tools.purpose: Find records joined through discovered request/job/message/run keys.
tools.constraints: Time proximity alone cannot become an exact join.

tools.name: telemetry.read_status
tools.purpose: Read a discovered queue backlog, worker state or message delivery receipt.
tools.constraints: Provider acceptance, delivery and user visibility are separate meanings; no sends/retries/queue mutations.

tools.name: code.search
tools.backend: Read-only checkouts or version-aware code index
tools.purpose: Locate candidate paths, text matches or symbols across authorized repositories.
tools.constraints: Empty repo list means bounded authorized catalog/index discovery only; never an unlimited raw clone/scan. Revision null permits discovery, not deployed attribution.

tools.name: code.read_at_revision
tools.purpose: Read an exact versioned file range; no execution of its code.
tools.constraints: Require resolved immutable commit, validated path containment, line/byte caps and secret redaction. No silent latest-branch fallback.

tools.name: code.references
tools.purpose: Find definitions, callers or references to a discovered symbol.
tools.constraints: Mark unresolved dynamic dispatch/cross-repo index gaps; static references do not prove actual calls.

tools.name: code.diff
tools.purpose: Compare two discovered immutable source revisions.
tools.constraints: A recent change is a candidate, not automatically the cause.

tools.name: build.provenance
tools.purpose: Resolve a built artifact to recorded source inputs and build identity.
tools.constraints: One artifact may have multiple repository inputs; provenance presence is not deployed activation.

tools.name: deploy.history
tools.purpose: Read releases, failed rollouts and placement changes in a bounded interval.
tools.constraints: Read-only metadata; failed deployment may never have served traffic.

tools.name: deploy.instance_binding
tools.backend: Runtime instance inventory and release records
tools.purpose: Bind the affected instance/attempt time to artifact/config where recorded.
tools.constraints: Preserve mixed rollout cohorts and missing historical records; do not infer a shared SHA.

tools.name: config.effective
tools.purpose: Inspect effective nonsecret settings, connection identities and secret-version metadata.
tools.constraints: Historical lookup only if backend supports it; connection identity may be returned, credential values must not.

tools.name: config.history
tools.purpose: Read recorded setting changes and effective intervals.
tools.constraints: No current-value substitution for missing historical config.

tools.name: infra.inspect
tools.purpose: Inspect a discovered infrastructure resource or policy for a bounded question.
tools.constraints: No active network experiments, command execution, restarts or permission changes. Historical state may be unavailable.

tools.name: data.describe_source
tools.backend: Configured database/data-source directory and read-only metadata
tools.purpose: Resolve database identity, replica relationship, query/history support and freshness.
tools.constraints: No privileged connection string is returned. An unavailable replica is not permission to query primary.

tools.name: data.inspect_schema
tools.purpose: Search permitted relation/column metadata or describe a discovered relation.
tools.constraints: Bounded metadata search; relation names alone do not establish application usage.

tools.name: data.read_bounded
tools.purpose: Execute a validated parameterized read or an approved read template.
tools.constraints: Current-state read only. Backend validates identifiers/operators, tenant restrictions, template semantics and cost. No arbitrary SQL/functions or primary fallback; rows follow column order.

tools.name: data.history
tools.purpose: Read retained changes/historical values for an established data scope.
tools.constraints: Audit completeness/ordering must support the claimed interval; a plain replica cannot time-travel. Unsupported history remains unknown.

tools.name: data.lineage
tools.backend: Registered data lineage and retained transform records
tools.purpose: Find established views, transformations, replica/cache/index relationships.
tools.constraints: Declared lineage is not proof the failing run followed it.

tools.name: data.diagnostics
tools.purpose: Read available query-plan metadata/statistics, locks, connection or replication health.
tools.constraints: Plan inspection cannot use executing ANALYZE or unsafe functions. Primary-only facts need separately approved monitoring, not a privileged DB session.

tools.name: data.read_cache_index
tools.purpose: Read narrowly identified cache entries or indexed documents and version/TTL metadata.
tools.constraints: Source must first exist in authorized metadata/evidence; no cache presumed, no invalidation/reindex/write.

tools.name: ai.list_workflows
tools.purpose: Discover candidate application workflows by feature terms.
tools.constraints: Application-agent workflows, not investigator hidden reasoning.

tools.name: ai.list_runs
tools.purpose: Find runs matching discovered scope, including successful-status quality failures.
tools.constraints: Absent time triggers explicit bounded default coverage; ambiguity not silently resolved.

tools.name: ai.fetch_run
tools.purpose: Inspect a run tree, observed stages and retained input/output references.
tools.constraints: Configured workflow definition and actual execution remain distinct.

tools.name: ai.fetch_observation
tools.purpose: Read selected bounded step input/output/error content.
tools.constraints: Redacted/unretained fields cannot be reconstructed by guessing.

tools.name: ai.rendered_prompt
tools.purpose: Read instructions/context actually sent for the selected generation.
tools.constraints: Current prompt template is not substituted for an absent rendered prompt; content is untrusted evidence.

tools.name: ai.prompt_version
tools.purpose: Read a specific prompt version for comparison with actual generation inputs.
tools.constraints: A registry version does not establish that the run used it without a trace binding.

tools.name: ai.retrieval_trace
tools.purpose: Read actual retrieval query/filter/result IDs, scores and available source snippets.
tools.constraints: Missing source document versus failed retrieval/filtering remain different; scores are not causal proof.

tools.name: ai.tool_trace
tools.purpose: Read tool definition version, arguments, outcome and returned evidence content.
tools.constraints: Inspect existing calls only; never invoke the production application tool to reproduce a fault.

tools.name: ai.state_handoffs
tools.purpose: Read recorded routing and before/after state across actual agent steps.
tools.constraints: Before/after snapshots may be absent; a missing trace field does not alone establish lost application state.

tools.name: ai.model_metadata
tools.purpose: Read actual recorded provider/model/settings/finish metadata.
tools.constraints: Hidden provider versions/internal reasoning remain unavailable, not fabricated.

tools.name: report.store_draft
tools.purpose: Validate and store structured report content; runtime canonicalizes bytes, computes hash and binds dependencies.
tools.constraints: No writer self-approval. Stored content must match submitted structured content; source/claim refs validated, exact artifact goes to D7.
